reviews.x: It's nice, but I wish manufacturers would consider the exact needs of the customer. No one wants a wrap that will slide all over you head or slide off. I am constantly adjusting this cap. And it your buying to protect your hair during sleep, set an alarm to wake up every ten minutes to search for the wrap and put it back on your head.

Very disappointed in this bonnet. I did the whole silk pillowcase thing to protect my hair, but got tired of hand washing it. I thought a silk bonnet would be a great alternative. These are pretty, but absolutely do not stay on when you lay your head down. I tried to wear it on 3 separate nights, but if you move at all, so does your bonnet. There is little to no elastic around the opening for your head. Every time I woke up, it was no longer on my head. If you just want one to wear around the ho
Love the soft material but highly disappointed and the quality of the dye job. Slept in this particular one and the next morning my pillow cases and neck pillow was cover than this dye stains
Not what I expected. It didn't stay on for me, I didn't feel any stretch or elastic. They are small, so if you have a lot of hair it would not work.
This is a hand made item; poorly stitched; no quality control and not worth the price.

reviews.t: Buy it, you won’t regret it!
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:26f7ab39e3a95838582ec63ad2600e7d]] I LOVE the color combo! A bit shiny but perfect for large heads😍 comfortable and chic! Get it and the price you can’t beat!!  Enjoy!

My first silk bonnet purchase, in retrospect, wasn’t bad. It was big so it looked like a deflated chefs hat when I wore it but it stayed on and my kept my curls intact. I sought a different one because it would leave a mark across my forehead or fall to much forward at night so I’d awake with a silk curtain over my face.  I bought these as they looked fitted and didn’t look like they would cut into my forehead. Nope, these are small so it fit like a swimmers cap.  Nonetheless I slept in it only

I LOVE the look of these caps. I have a head on the larger side. Unfortunately, there is literally no stretch to these babies. I was shocked to discover that these still fit over my head, however they will not stay put. Simply tilting my head 70 degrees to one side will cause it to start sliding off. Do not waste your money! I have no idea how people with smaller heads (most other women) have had success with these giant non-elastic monsters. Extremely disappointed.

Material seems good and silky. Fit okay but i think its cause i have alot of thick hair and im terrible at braiding so my hair is hard to get all in it. But if you can braid your hair this would be a great sleeping bonnet to protect from frizz and tangles.
I bought these to sleep in. They are way to small can’t fit all my hair in there. Not worth the money.

I like the look and style of this item.I also like the colors. The black is great as is the colorful pink and orange one. Different headcoverings for different moods.  Because my hair is short,they fit me loose and comfortable.They also feel really nice. If you need to take time to make your hair presentable buy these. They are great and I am a satisfied customer. Whenever someone rin gs my bell I reach for my turban and it's great to sleep in too.

reviews.t: A little bit small for my head
reviews.x: These are a little bit small for my head. So they end up slipping off. The material is great. But maybe securing your head tighter at night may help with placement. I got them to protect hair extensions overnight so it’s a lot of hair inside cap.. more elasticity would be helpful
The only reason I'm giving 4 stars instead of 5 is that the color ran on the black one & stained the other one in the wash.
Didn’t fit my head and all my hair wasn’t even in the wrap.  Came off in the middle of the night.
Cute but these do not stay on. I have shoulder length hair. This constantly slips off my head.

I bought these to protect my hair when I'm sleeping with my CPAP machine.  I'd been putting my hair in a pony tail before putting on the headgear, but this cap is actually easier and gives much better protection.  I just put the cap on, let any hair not in the cap hang out below the cap, and put on the headgear.  It stays on just fine because the headgear holds it on.  It looks a lot better than a shower cap style silk or satin head covering too.

Use for sleeping with hair extensions. They are comfortable enough and keep my hair wrapped at night HOWEVER, be warned if you have blonde hair. The pink color transferred onto my hair leaving a ring of pink around my head. It took approx. 3 washes with clarifying shampoo to remove the pink stain from my hair. I now only use the black which doesn’t seem to transfer color.

CHRONIC HOSPITAL STAYS HAVE DESTROYED MY LONG LUSCIOUS LOCKS! SINCE MY DISCOVERY OF COMBINING THESE SILK TURBANS WITH SILK PILLOWCASES I'VE HAD  GREAT SUCCESS WITH HAIR REGROWTH THAT'S SHINY & HEALTHY! MY COMPLAINT WOULD BE THEY'RE A TAD SMALL TO ACCOMODATE SO MUCH HAIR NOW AND THEY TEND TO SLIP & SLIDE ON MY NEW SILKY HAIR!

reviews.t: Better for shorter styles. Won’t fit over set hair.
reviews.x: These are very tight if you have a lot of hair. These would be more suited for shorter styles. Sometimes I set my hair at night and I wanted to be able to pull this over to sleep without disturbing the set. It didn’t fit over the flexi-rod set. The material it is made of is very nice. The elastic could be more flexible.

I am new to bonnets, as I’ve started a journey taking better care of my natural curls. But this bonnet was noisy to me when I laid my head on my pillow, and never stayed in place. I prefer the cotton outer layer with silk inner layer bonnets. They seem to stay where I need them to better than this fabric.

Cute. Fit perfectly. Stayed on while sleeping. Just be warned the elastic is only in a small section on the back of the neck and none of them come with a bow. The bow was a main reason I bought these and neither of them came with the bow. Very disappointed. Other than that they work well!

These RUINED my crate and barrel dresser, nightstand and bedding... Even my manicure!!! THE DYE TRANSFERS TO WHATEVER SURFACE IT SITS ON!! I wish I never bought these cheap things! Nowhere in the description does it mention due transfer. Horrible.

Both the black and pink/orange colors rub off on my pillowcase. I have washed them multiple times with color catchers to absorb any excess color transfer, but they both still stain my pillowcase if I have leave-in product on my hair

reviews.t: Silky, Smooth, but a Bit too Big!
reviews.x: The Fabric is soft and comfortable, However they do not stay in place. The black one had the stitching coming apart in the back when I first received it.  The colored one had no defects, it was slightly too big for my head.

I ordered this wrap for my coconut oil treatments. The wrap is very comfortable and stayed on all night however when I woke up in the morning the dye transferred to my pillow case. Thankfully it didn’t dye my skin or hair.

claims.text: Many reviewers report the bonnet does not stay on, especially during sleep, and slips off the head.
Several reviewers find the sizing too small or lacking stretch, making it hard to fit all their hair, particularly for those with lots of thick hair.
Some reviewers praise the soft, silky material and attractive colors/looks.
A few reviewers report quality problems such as dye staining or poor stitching.
Some reviewers find it comfortable and good value for the price.
